node.statement: Define Upsilon'_j(T):=Lambda_j^*(Phi(T) tensor I_F)Lambda_j and Upsilon'(T):=(Upsilon'_j(T))_{j=1}^m; tensoring the CP map Phi with I_F, compression by Lambda_j, and finite direct sums preserve complete positivity, so every Upsilon'_j and Upsilon' are CP, and at every amplification the direct-sum maximum norm and ||Lambda_j|| <= 1 give ||Upsilon'||_cb <= 1 with no block-count or amplification factor.
